pages.title: Readiness checklist
pages.text:
Finish the remaining quest branches and seat all **nine** Strand tokens. Count the Post notches before leaving for the final materials.\
Prepare food, equipment and a return route before entering the March. Bring back **March Stone**. Read the Spirit Codex for the Gate Drum and March travel details.

pages.title: Use the Post twice
pages.text:
1\. With all nine Strands seated, right-click the Tension Post with March Stone. This makes a **Spindle Loom Fragment**.\
2\. Right-click the Post again, this time holding the Fragment, to reweave your team's sky.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: These are world interactions, not crafting-table recipes. If nothing happens, check the Post message and the nine seated Strands. Other teams have their own progress.
